description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex, email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex; existing capability snapshot owner
Add verified SMTP attachment preparation/submission and exact encoded-size checks using current shared settings.file_delivery. Select actual outbound SMTP connection even for IMAP-origin replies and freeze sender/config/requirements. Advertise file support and send_with_attachments only with working implementation. Preserve existing UI and shared validation; no old SMTP-specific settings import.

Tests to add before implementation: MIME size boundaries, configured count, absent required values, prepared display metadata, IMAP-to-selected-SMTP identity, sender isolation, thread headers, prepare-all-before-submit, partial submissions.

Branches/paths validated: MIME size boundaries, configured count, absent required values, prepared display metadata, IMAP-to-selected-SMTP identity, sender isolation, thread headers, prepare-all-before-submit, partial submissions.

Action reuse assessment: Extend existing SmtpSender and EmailBridge; reuse shared FileSettings and TransportRequirements. SMTP is transport infrastructure, not a new Action. Existing email history/notification ownership remains.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.

Approved preparation-failure contract (2026-11-27): Preserve reference behavior for attachment acquisition/preparation failures before publication. Abort stops without publishing messages after preparation failure. Continue publishes the answer with usable attachments and reports failed attachments; if none can be prepared, publish the answer as text only while retaining attachment failure evidence. Failed attachments must never be reported as delivered. This does not authorize fallback after uncertain publication or settle unresolved transport-configuration handling. Apply policy in the Channel execution layer using current shared settings; keep the planner pure, original attachment indices stable, and Plan separate from Outgoing. Do not restore the old selection-failure notice route. Acceptance tests: mixed valid/invalid preparation under both policies; no usable files under continue; later direct-send group preparation failure prevents every publication under abort; failed acquisition is not retried for reused indices; outcomes retain failures and confirmed-only attachment evidence. Reference: ../zaq-feat-channel-files/test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/outgoing_attachments_test.exs and delivery/group_execution_test.exs. Planning update only; no code or existing tests changed.

Approved operation-deadline contract (2026-11-27): Preserve a configurable default timeout of 30,000 ms per upload, send or edit, including sole sends and existing-message edits. Execute transport operations in supervised tasks and terminate timed-out local tasks. Timeout/task exit remains unconfirmed, since local termination does not prove provider rejection. Never retry the operation automatically; apply approved abort/continue and root-promotion rules to subsequent operations. This is a per-operation deadline, not a whole-attempt deadline. Executor regression tests must cover upload/send/edit timeouts, task exits, earlier-confirmation preservation, unattempted steps under abort and no repeated invocation. Runtime configuration must retain the established injectable config boundary. Planning update only; implementation remains pending.

Approved requirements-resolution failure policy (2026-11-27): Preserve reference behavior. When attachment transport requirements cannot be resolved, continue may deliver the original answer as text only, without acquiring or uploading attachments, while retaining each attachment configuration failure in the outcome. Abort returns the failure without sending. The Channel execution/orchestration layer applies the selected connection shared failure policy; TransportRequirements.resolve/2 and the metadata planner return errors unchanged. Do not restore bridge-owned requirements resolvers or fabricate capability support. Fallback requires a valid text-delivery connection and must obey its transport constraints; it does not bypass authentication, connector selection or message sizing. Optional unresolved byte limits accepted by the current resolver are not resolution errors. Acceptance: continue text fallback with zero acquisition/upload; abort no send; failed attachments never confirmed; selected connection policy and text limits retained; accepted optional unresolved limits do not trigger fallback. Reference: ../zaq-feat-channel-files/test/zaq/channels/delivery/executor_test.exs, requirements-error fallback test. Carry this into pending executor/API integration issues. Planning only; no code/test changes.

Approved exact SMTP sizing contract (2026-11-27): Prepare complete encoded MIME, including attachments and headers; measure against the selected connection message limit; submit the measured representation without rebuilding it. Re-encode and revalidate when final thread/continuation headers change before submission. Disable automatic SMTP retries. Confirmation means relay acceptance, not recipient delivery. A rejected oversized continuation preserves earlier confirmed messages. Verify compatibility with current Swoosh/gen_smtp dependencies before choosing the preparation/submission seam; do not blindly copy reference hardcoded version checks. Acceptance: exact boundary succeeds, over-limit fails before submission, continuation-header overflow retains earlier confirmation, measured MIME matches actual SMTP submission including framing, no automatic retry, selected sender/config/envelope isolation, prepared bytes excluded from logs/telemetry. Reference: ../zaq-feat-channel-files/lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex and test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/outgoing_attachments_test.exs. Planning update only; implementation pending.

comments.text: Moved to PR5 per Jad seven-PR split. Not part of feat/delivery_plan PR4. Existing functional/test/reuse specification retained. Executor prerequisite and PR5 review/coverage finalization must be planned before implementation.
